events.note: Authored for credential-evidence#235 (Batch 2 handoff) from the cited provider pages; carrier existence is provider-documented, the context policy is project policy. Not an independent review.

Decided 2026-10-05 by the sole maintainer (Milo Kang, milocosmopolitan, repository owner) for credential-evidence#235. Question: the value of the access_token member or of a Bearer header of a Salesforce OAuth access token is a credential, with no bare-value rule? Options: add a value-shape expectation for the token; or leave the case a draft. Decision: flag the value in the documented member or header; no bare-value expectation, no connected app or external client app subtype. Reason: the provider pages document the carrier, not a value format or a subtype, so the expectation rests on project policy and is not a provider rule or a fact. Finalized by the sole maintainer alone under the solo-maintainer period (ADR 0020): not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). Recorded by an AI agent on the owner's instruction.
events.dissent: The provider pages document the carrier but state no value format, so a position-only rule can flag non-secrets or miss a differently shaped secret; leaving the case a draft would understate nothing and claim nothing.
events.reversingEvidence: A provider statement of the value format or of the carrier's confidentiality that contradicts this outcome, or a second maintainer's retro-review that disputes it.
